name: Beast Realm Maneater
lore: A predator from a Beast Realm where instinct became law. It is not evil in a human sense; it is a living argument that survival has no court of appeal.
visualDescription: Mythic lion-wolf-serpent predator, bone mane, ember eyes, ancient scars, earth-dark hide, non-sci-fi monster silhouette.
mapBehavior: Tracks wounded Titans and escalates if ignored.

scaling.campaign: Fixed mission bands; old wins should become easier as Titan level and gear rise.
scaling.eliteRemix: +12% hp, +10% damage, +1 mechanic layer, +1 tactical AI priority.
scaling.endgame: Dynamic scaling is capped at player effective level +8; adds mechanics before raw hp.
scaling.levelFormula: hp = baseHp * (1 + 0.045 * missionLevel); damage = baseDamage * (1 + 0.035 * missionLevel), capped by tier budget

aiProfile.counterplayWindow: Every major action has a telegraph or setup turn unless spawned as a minor swarmer.

balanceNotes: Harder solo tuning: Major EXECUTIONER pressures one active Titan through behavior first, stats second; threatWeight 2.0 controls encounter budgets.
